recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No additional core source work is needed for FHIR-37442; any future desire to restructure package guidance or make parts informative again should be handled as a new work-group decision rather than as this R5 documentation request.
issue_request: FHIR-37442 was Published as Persuasive for R5. It asked FHIR-I to describe, in the specification and/or linked Confluence pages, when and how FHIR packages are used because FHIR had begun relying extensively on packages and there had been CI-build package-version discrepancies. The resolution said Grahame would provide the description and that it would not be normative content.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentions FHIR-37442, but commit c9186a64e1e317ec9402214ade4ce4f2e4c69ffd added source/packages.html on 2022-08-11 as candidate NPM package documentation after the Jira vote. The R5 history page records "Documented FHIR NPM Packages", and current build inputs list packages.html in the site hierarchy, documentation index, and publish list.
additional_context: The current source/packages.html page describes FHIR NPM package purpose, structure, package.json metadata, examples, .index.json, package composition, caching, and registry use. Later package-page decisions changed how the original non-normative note should be interpreted: FHIR-46072 deliberately made the package page Normative in R6 because it contains mandatory package metadata text, and FHIR-50860 plus FHIR-48547 added later package guidance on the same active page. Those related issues are already represented on the combined branch and do not create a remaining FHIR-37442 source gap.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active current specification already contains the package documentation requested by FHIR-37442, and reverting or weakening the current Normative status would conflict with the later Applied FHIR-46072 decision.

related_jiras.note: Versioning-policy issue cited by FHIR-37442 as context for package version discrepancies; it is a separate published versioning change, not a package-documentation source gap.
